name: Joy
overview: Scripture reveals joy as a profound response to God's mighty acts and His covenantal blessings, as seen when Moses and Israel sang in triumph after deliverance (Exodus 15:1) and when God's people are commanded to rejoice before Him in their labors (Deuteronomy 12:18). This joy is deeply connected to God's favor and provision, with the Lord rejoicing over His people in both blessing and judgment (Deuteronomy 28:63; 30:9). True happiness is found in being a people saved by the Lord, secure in His protection and strength (Deuteronomy 33:29), distinguishing godly joy from fleeting worldly pleasure.
